§ 01 · The Program

A complete
portfolio.

From foundational B1 wholesale vocabulary to advanced C1 distribution strategy and analytics discourse, every module is anchored in real-world wholesale scenarios — from bulk purchasing to warehouse automation, from supplier contracts to e-commerce marketplaces. Built for use inside distributors, wholesalers, import-export firms, and B2B trading platforms.

Industry-anchored

AI-powered demand planning, automated warehousing, and predictive inventory systems run throughout the program — reflecting today's wholesale industry.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Wholesale Business English Expert

Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international wholesale professionals. Ledger reflects his vision: language learning as trade capability — a multiplier of careers, networks, and influence.

Designed for the distribution executives, procurement leaders, and supply chain managers moving the world's goods — Ledger is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to move bulk trade forward in one of the most foundational industries in the world.
